_comment: Fingerprint of the committed flash image; the sketch hash is compared against the .ino so a stale image cannot be flashed silently in place of an edited sketch.
r_sense_warning: the v3 chirp used 0.10 for a board marked R100; verify the board actually fitted before running
safety: 150-250 Hz caused uncontrolled motor motion on 2026-09-15; the FULL profile omits the band entirely rather than attenuating it
